LESSON: MANAGING WASTE ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Care for the
Topic 3.3: Managing waste environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Managing waste environment. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate a clean classroom environment for good health

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: MANAGING WASTE ENVIRONMENT
This lesson teaches Managing waste environment for Grade 1 ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. appreciate a clean classroom environment for good health
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Managing waste environment using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Managing waste environment above.
2. Explain Managing waste environment to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Managing waste environment.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Managing waste environment with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Managing waste environment important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. appreciate a clean classroom environment for good health

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
